speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth whether the Hindu Endowments Board has undertaken a review of the case involving the alleged misappropriation and pawning of gold ceremonial jewellery between 2016 and 2020 with an aggregate pawn value amounting to more than $2 million at an endowment under its administration by its employee with a view to identify any shortcoming that led to the incident arising and steps to be taken to prevent such a situation from happening in the future at all its endowments.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The case is presently before the Courts and I will not go into the specific details of this case.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: However, I will share the follow-up actions that have been taken since the discovery of this case.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The Temple Management Committees will also tighten up oversight of all the gold inventories in their respective temples.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: HEB will continue to work with each of its Temple Management Committees to prevent abuse, and mitigate circumvention of governance controls.
